_doc: Wiring-pending allowlist for scripts/checks/mode-lifecycle-hooks-coverage.js (E-LIFECYCLE-001 / S-LC-02). A declared virtual lifecycle event with NO emitter yet (no `lifecycle-events.emit("<event>")` reference and no runtime `lifecycle-event` record) is reported as INFO — not a gap — IF it is listed here with a WELL-FORMED SCHEMA entry. This is the RAMP seam: S-LC-02 builds the registry + logger + enforcer but NOT the emitters (the 2 REAL PreToolUse guards + the mode-switch/teardown/init/session wiring are S-LC-03/04). As each emit-site lands, PRUNE its entry here; once an event has a real emitter the enforcer counts it covered and the allowlist entry is redundant. A declared event that is NEITHER emitted NOR a valid in-date allowlist entry is a real coverage GAP (report-only this sprint; --enforce makes it exit 1). Mirrors the MIGRATION_PENDING / flag-don't-fix-known-debt pattern (mode-lifecycle-registry, cutover-completeness).
_schema: SP-20260611-002 R-9 / S-9 (AC-9.1..9.3): each wiring_pending entry MUST be an object carrying { owner, review_by (or expiry), reason }. owner = the role/sprint accountable for landing the emitter; review_by/expiry = an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date by which the entry must be revisited (a PAST date is FLAGGED → downgraded to a gap, so a permanent silent allowlist cannot suppress an emitter-gap forever); reason = why the emitter is not wired yet. A schemaless entry (missing owner/review_by/reason, or a bare string) is REJECTED — it is NOT honored as pending and falls through to a coverage GAP. A well-formed, in-date entry is honored as INFO (not a gap). Legacy bare-string values are no longer accepted.
